About Purvey

Good tools should be within reach.

We’re making it easier for Nigerian businesses to sell online and stay organised, with a storefront and everyday tools they can manage themselves.

The story behind Purvey
Your business, organised.

From your first product to your next order.

01 Where it started

A familiar starting point.Helping businesses find their place online through Secern.

A website was only part of the job.

Purvey grew out of work at Secern, where our founder designed and built websites for businesses. Getting a business online was a useful first step. Keeping products, stock, orders and customer details organised was another challenge.

For a small business, paying for a custom website and finding separate tools to run it can be a lot to take on. Making a simple change shouldn’t mean waiting for a developer.

That led to Purvey: a way to create a storefront and manage the work behind it, without having to put all the pieces together yourself.

02 · What we’re building

Useful tools. Less everyday friction.

A place for your products, a clearer view of your business, and fewer details scattered across different places.

01

Give your products a home.

Create a storefront customers can browse and order from. Share the link through WhatsApp, Instagram or wherever the conversation starts.

02

Keep the details together.

Manage products, variations, stock, orders and customer history in one place. Make the updates yourself as your business changes.

03

Know where things stand.

Follow orders, payments and settlements, so you can see what needs attention and decide what to do next.

03 Meet the founder

Hi, I’m Lanre.

I’m a product designer and web developer with over five years of experience. I started Secern to help businesses build their presence online, and I’ve designed and developed Purvey myself.

I’m building Purvey around a simple idea: business owners should have access to useful tools they can understand and use, even when they’re just starting out.

That means paying attention to the small things: adding a product, checking an order, updating stock. Those are the things merchants come back to every day, and they deserve care.

04 · The company behind Purvey

Built by Secern. Made for everyday business.

Purvey is a product of Secern Technologies Limited, a Nigerian technology company. Our focus is making online selling and day-to-day business management easier to access and simpler to use.
